challenge: Channeling the flat, poster-ready aesthetic of early Bauhaus design through a modern generative lens. The goal was to create compositions that honor the movement's commitment to simple forms, modular grids, and bold color blocking while maintaining a retro warmth that feels accessible and contemporary.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to establish primary shapes and grid rhythms, then refined edge quality, color steps, and spatial balance in Lightroom and Illustrator. Each panel was treated as a modular unit, ensuring the series maintains visual consistency across the full collection.
result: Delivered a six-piece retro Bauhaus collection with crisp, flat compositions that pop at tile scale and hold their graphic integrity at print resolution. The series bridges mid-century design sensibility with contemporary generative process.
